project.title: TrailCam CF10 low-profile FPV rover functional redesign

coordinate_frame.origin: vehicle longitudinal center plane at the lowest payload mounting datum
coordinate_frame.transform_convention: row-major 4x4 matrix maps component source coordinates to project millimetres

requirements.statement: The rover shall provide a forward analog-FPV view through a guarded RunCam Phoenix 2 SE V2-class camera and a separately mounted SpeedyBee TX800-class VTX.
requirements.verification: measured COTS envelopes, field-of-view collision test, power/thermal bench test and supervised video-under-load test

requirements.statement: Control shall use the EdgeTX/ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz LBT family through a rover-specific PWM receiver, independent of the analog video link.
requirements.verification: wiring review, failsafe test with total video loss, stall/brownout test and controlled range test

requirements.statement: Primary payload loads shall pass through measured chassis hardpoints, adapter nodes and two rails; bodyposts may locate only a light cover.
requirements.verification: datum inspection, load-path section review, clamp-slip test and proof-load test

requirements.statement: The traction battery shall remain in the lowest approved purchased-chassis position and the upper electronics bridge shall be open, ribbed and serviceable.
requirements.verification: assembly proxy, center-of-mass comparison and service-access review

requirements.statement: No payload component, cable or fastener may enter steering, suspension, wheel, driveshaft, motor, battery-access, disconnect, camera-view or RF-active keep-outs.
requirements.verification: exact CAD collision and swept-volume checks plus full-travel physical inspection

requirements.statement: Printed functional components shall be deterministic CadQuery B-Rep solids with STEP, watertight STL and 3MF handoff outputs after concept and decomposition approval.
requirements.verification: source regeneration, solid audit, mesh validation and exact slicer preflight

global_style.summary: low-profile technical crawler payload with dark structural rails and orange replaceable protection/service accents
global_style.generation_material: matte black and charcoal functional polymers with restrained orange service accents
global_style.detail_hierarchy: measured interfaces first, camera and RF protection second, low technical silhouette third

assembly_sequence: Measure and freeze the exact purchased chassis, hardpoints, rail section, motion envelopes and battery/disconnect access.
Attach ADAPTER_SET to CHASSIS_COTS with HARDWARE_KIT and verify full suspension/steering travel.
Capture the two RAILS_COTS in split clamps without drilling the rails.
Fasten ELECTRONICS_BRIDGE to the rails and verify load path, tool access and battery removal.
Install CAMERA_COTS in CAMERA_GUARD, then install the guarded module at the front bridge interface.
Install RX_COTS and VTX_COTS in their separated RF_MOUNT_SET bodies with cable strain relief and antenna keep-outs.
Complete electrical, failsafe, thermal, RF, load and low-speed driving checks before FPV operation.

decision_log.topic: Approve concept revision 0.3.0-r2 and this functional decomposition before production CAD.
decision_log.current_basis: Requirements revision 0.3.0 is approved; the selected concept and decomposition are awaiting explicit human approval.
decision_log.evidence_needed: User approval or corrections naming concept revision 0.3.0-r2 and the decomposition direction.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the exact 1:10 crawler chassis revision and measured hardpoint/motion contract.
decision_log.current_basis: Tamiya CC-02 is only the recommended first reference; legacy dimensions are not verified.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Named chassis kit/revision, calibrated measurements, hardpoint table, motion sweeps and battery/disconnect envelope.

decision_log.topic: Freeze measured camera, VTX, receiver, antenna, connector, cable and fastener envelopes.
decision_log.current_basis: RunCam Phoenix 2 SE V2, SpeedyBee TX800 and RadioMaster ER5C are platform-family candidates, not measured CAD authorities.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Exact purchased revisions, supplier drawings, calibrated samples, connector exits, bend radii and antenna active-element boundaries.

decision_log.topic: Approve payload mass, proof load and impact severity.
decision_log.current_basis: Planning values are 500 g service payload, 1000 g static proof load and supervised operation at or below 5 km/h.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Weighed electronics assembly, approved test fixture and test acceptance confirmation.

decision_log.topic: Freeze printer, PETG product, material condition, orientation and Anycubic process profile.
decision_log.current_basis: Kobra 3 Max, 0.6 mm nozzle, 0.66 mm line width and 0.24 mm layers are planning assumptions.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Complete exact machine/process/filament JSON profiles and process-matched coupon results.

decision_log.topic: Select RadioMaster MT12 ELRS or protocol-family-compatible Pocket transmitter ergonomics.
decision_log.current_basis: MT12 is recommended for surface controls; Pocket preserves more operator familiarity with OpenQuad.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Operator choice plus bound-receiver, channel-map and failsafe evidence.
